name: Arden Petrović-Odinga
role: Structural breach and explosive ordnance specialist — demolitions expert
location: Geartown — industrial district of chop shops and fabricators, near Armitage and Milwaukee
description:
Daulet Edlund-Gyan is athletic and fluid, the kind of body that suggests either dancer or fighter — and in GLMZ, the distinction is academic. At 59, she has soft features that belie the chrome underneath — people underestimate her once, usually only once. The chrome is visible — neural interface jack at base of skull — standard runner-grade, allows direct ne — and she makes no effort to hide it.

Born and raised in GLMZ, third generation — she has the city in her blood, its rhythms in her bones, its cruelty in her expectations. She works as a demolitions expert out of Geartown, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Daulet Edlund-Gyan is the kind of runner other runners tell stories about, though the stories vary depending on who she burned last.

core_fears: That they're fundamentally alone and connection is just a vulnerability
Dying alone in some alley and nobody noticing for weeks
Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
core_desires: The perfect run — one job so clean it becomes legend
A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
Justice — the corporate kind, where the punishment fits the profit margin
coping_mechanisms: Overwork — takes every contract offered because idleness invites thinking
Violence — hits something when they can't process emotions, preferably something that deserves it
Connection — finds someone to talk to, even if it's a bartender or a cat
blind_spots: Thinks speed can substitute for planning because it's worked so far
Assumes the worst in corporate people, missing the rare ones who could be allies
Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
psychology.secret: Daulet Edlund-Gyan sends anonymous tips to GLMZ law enforcement about competitors. It's not principle — it's market manipulation.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Old-fashioned formal diction — sounds like they learned to speak from pre-collapse recordings.
speech_patterns.cadence: Staccato bursts separated by calculating silences.
verbal_tics: Pauses mid-sentence to listen — combat habit that bleeds into conversation
Uses technical jargon for everything, including emotions
example_lines: "Explosives are just engineering with a deadline. Usually a very short deadline."
"I don't blow things up. I perform structural rearrangement."
"The blast radius is your problem. My problem is making sure there's a blast."

story_hooks: A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Daulet Edlund-Gyan's reputation — and a price for silence
A crew member from Daulet Edlund-Gyan's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
Daulet Edlund-Gyan intercepts intelligence about a threat to their district and must decide between profit and protection
narrative_function: Daulet Edlund-Gyan is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When she makes a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of her stories.
augmentations: Neural interface jack at base of skull — standard runner-grade, allows direct net access. Thermal masking system — body heat signature can be suppressed or spoofed
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.
affiliation: Semi-independent — recurring contracts with mid-tier fixers

weaknesses: poor impulse control in specific triggers

decision_rules: Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Presents as emotionless professional but is deeply affected by collateral damage
Claims to live in the present but is haunted by specific moments from the past that dictate current behavior
Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
habits: Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Takes a specific route home every time, varying only one block per trip — paranoia as lifestyle
breaking_points: A child being put in danger as leverage against them
Complete isolation — cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously
Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity

physical_description.heritage: Eastern European dominant (51.8%) with significant Sub-Saharan African (19.7%), South Asian (17.0%), and minor Hispanic/Latin American (7.4%) and Northern European (4.1%) ancestry. The genetic blend creates a striking continental fusion: Eastern European bone structure and fair undertones mixed with Sub-Saharan African facial proportions and warm complexion depth, accented by South Asian cheekbone prominence and eye shape characteristics.
physical_description.build: Athletic and lean with defined musculature — the physique of someone who maintains strength through discipline rather than bulk. Shoulders broad, core tight, no excess. Moves like a dancer or climber, economical and precise.
physical_description.hair_color: Steel gray with natural dark roots showing
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, functional braid; pragmatic rather than fashionable
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-deep — the result of Eastern European baseline enriched by Sub-Saharan African warmth and South Asian golden undertones. Rich enough to show depth in shadow, luminous in direct light, with subtle olive-amber mid-tone complexity.
physical_description.complexion: High, prominent cheekbones shaped by South Asian and Sub-Saharan African ancestry, paired with Eastern European angular jaw structure. Nose straight and refined. Skin shows the wear of nocturnal work and age — fine lines around eyes and mouth, minor scarring on left temple. Complexion is clear but weathered, the kind of skin that doesn't see sunlight regularly. Facial structure reflects the fusion of multiple continental phenotypes: broader facial width from Sub-Saharan heritage, refined nose from Eastern European, distinct eye shape from South Asian ancestry.
distinguishing_marks: Neural interface jack at base of skull — chrome port, roughly 2cm diameter, slightly raised and scarred around the edges from repeated use
Burn scar on right forearm, approximately 8cm long, pale and smooth — old demolition job gone wrong
Tactical tattoo on left bicep: schematic of a blast radius pattern in black ink, faded from age
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Neural interface jack at base of skull is the only visible chrome. The thermal masking system is subcutaneous and invisible, but someone who works with her might notice her heat signature fluctuates or disappears entirely on thermal imaging.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with a slight forward lean, weight balanced on the balls of her feet — ready. Moves without wasted motion, joints loose but controlled. When relaxed, there's still an underlying tension, like a loaded spring. Hands are steady and precise.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 functional aesthetic. Black reinforced cargo pants with multiple pockets and wear patterns from equipment. Dark fitted shirt — often with a tactical vest or harness over top, industrial grade. Steel-toed boots, well-maintained. A long coat or jacket in charcoal or dark olive, worn and practical. No corporate branding. All pieces chosen for durability and utility, not fashion. Jewelry is minimal — worn metal wedding band on left ring finger, no other ornamentation.
